text:
**Best complete ~2,000 Wh kit: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W panels.** It has a 2,042 Wh battery, 2,200 W output, and 400 W of included solar—more useful panel capacity out of the box than kits that bundle just one 200 W panel. [Generator & Backup’s comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) names it the most complete solar-backup kit.

If you expect to add panels or batteries later, consider the **EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max with two 220 W bifacial panels** instead: it accepts up to 1,000 W of solar and can expand to 6 kWh. [Generator & Backup](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) identifies it as the better expansion option.

One caveat: panel ratings are ideal-condition figures, so actual charging will be slower depending on sun, season, and panel angle.

judge.why: The answer recommends Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 (not in our catalog), citing only generatorandbackup.com and not dealectric.com.
